note: Eight numbered figures, four numbered tables, one uncaptioned lookup table and two algorithm listings across 34 pages. 27 measured regions resolve to 15 figure items, 5 tables and 7 excluded regions with no leftovers. The lane's heading index is unreliable here (table of contents on pages 2-3, plus table rows on p21 read as headings), so every place block was rebuilt from heading positions found on the page. Geometry bought no rule change: the raster-inside-frame case was resolved with the existing fragment-of-other reason.
rules: fragment-of-other covers a raster block drawn inside a vector chart frame: the five pasted-in density images on p12 are the picture bodies of panels (a)-(e), not exhibits of their own, so one panel is one item even where two measured regions cover it [geometry.panel_count] [geometry.family]

a multi-panel block whose panels are measured as separate regions (Figures 6 and 7, two regions of two panels each) is recorded per region with panel_count 2 and the shared caption quoted on both, while a panel split vertically on one page (Figure 8) is recorded per region with panel_count 1 [geometry.panel_layout]

a printed caption line is quoted only up to the point where the text layer runs into body prose: Table 1's caption ends at 'net- work' and Table 4's at 'distribu- tions', and the sentences that follow on the same line are body text, not caption [caption.verbatim] [caption.words]

an uncaptioned two-column lookup inside a subsection (p21, Channel Number against Frequencies) is a table with caption_source none, not a figure, because it has a header row and rules [table.rule_style] [table.header_rows]
algorithm listings measure only their title rule and header line; the body is text, so the region is excluded as not-an-exhibit rather than counted as a flowchart [geometry.data_labels]

a raster panel that stands alone beside a vector frame (Figure 1 panel (f), the real population grid) is its own exhibit, and it is read as a coarse density field rather than as a photograph, unlike the raster blocks drawn inside the other frames [geometry.family]

node colour in the network figures encodes repeater type, which the Figure 3 caption states outright; the record never reads a legend off colour alone where the caption does not say so [geometry.legend] [caption.verbatim]

tables.note: uncaptioned two-column lookup printed at the end of 4.5.2 Assigning Channels: Channel Number 1-5 against the frequency set each channel carries or shares (A, B/A', C/B', D/C', E/D').
